==Description==
The '''Developer 1''' was an [[Enemies|enemy]] that only appeared in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and therefore only appeared in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode.

The '''Developer 1''' had a somewhat high amount of health (but it had lower health compared to the [[Glitched Giant]]) and walked at a fast pace. The '''Developer 1''' was spawned from the [[Creator]] and did not appear naturally in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]].

==Appearance==
As with the other developer [[enemies]] in the game, the '''Developer 1''' was a re-textured version of a developer of the game, more specifically, [https://www.roblox.com/users/209546354/profile Beefchoplets]. 

The '''Developer 1''' was faceless with reflective black skin and a dark green granite torso. Its legs were granite dark blue. A granite dark blue burger also appeared on the head of the '''Developer 1'''.

==Strategy==
*As with most enemies in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]], this enemy can be taken down with high DPS towers such as the [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] or [[Ranger]].
**The [[Commander]] helps greatly in defeating this [[Enemies|enemy]].
*This enemy can be slowed down by the [[Electroshocker]], [[Sledger]], [[Toxic Gunner]], [[Frost Blaster]] and [[Freezer]].

==Trivia==
*This [[Enemies|enemy]] is similar to the [[Developer 2]] and [[Developer 3]].
**Like these enemies, the '''Developer 1''' did not appear naturally in the [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] and was instead spawned by the [[Creator]].
*This enemy's appearance is based on [https://www.roblox.com/users/209546354/profile Beefchoplets], a retired developer of the game.
